<thought>We have repeatedly failed to find any commercially available precursors that can be connected to the target in a single step. All attempts to locate a suitable β‑keto‑acid, ketone, acid chloride, or related bicyclic compound returned false for buyability. Since the requirement is that every leaf node must be a commercially available chemical, and we cannot verify any such precursors, we cannot construct a valid one‑step retrosynthetic route that satisfies the constraints.</thought>
<final_answer>It is not possible to propose a one‑step retrosynthetic route to the target molecule COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O with all leaf precursors being commercially available under the given price limit.</final_answer>
